test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

A bed of nails

options.text: A person with no moral ethics
A fiercely contested fight or dispute

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase** "A bed of nails"** best expresses:* 'A problematic or uncomfortable situation'.*
 
• **"A bed of nails"** is an English idiom that refers to a situation or task that is full of difficulties or discomforts.
 
• The phrase comes from the image of lying on a bed made of nails, which would obviously be quite uncomfortable.

Therefore, the** correct answer **is:* 'A problematic or uncomfortable situation'*
